title: Week 31 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “central bank”?
options: Government decisions about spending, taxation, and borrowing that influence the economy.
A public institution managing monetary policy and supporting payment and financial stability functions.
The constitutional system through which states appoint electors who choose the president and vice president.
A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.
questions.explanation: Central bank means a public institution managing monetary policy and supporting payment and financial stability functions.
choices: Government decisions about spending, taxation, and borrowing that influence the economy.
A public institution managing monetary policy and supporting payment and financial stability functions.
The constitutional system through which states appoint electors who choose the president and vice president.
A legislature’s grant of authority to an executive agency or official.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “federal funds rate”?
options: A government payment that is not direct compensation for current production.
The interest rate on overnight reserve lending that the Federal Reserve targets within a range.
A legally recognized authority to use, exclude, transfer, or benefit from an asset subject to law.
A good commonly used with another good.
questions.explanation: Federal funds rate means the interest rate on overnight reserve lending that the Federal Reserve targets within a range.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “open market operation”?
options: Output measured with prices adjusted to remove the effect of inflation.
The process through which people develop political values, identities, and habits.
A central-bank purchase or sale of securities affecting reserves and short-term rates.
Powers retained by states or the people under the Tenth Amendment.
questions.explanation: Open market operation means a central-bank purchase or sale of securities affecting reserves and short-term rates.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “discount rate”?
options: The rate charged on eligible borrowing from Federal Reserve lending facilities.
A formal process in which officials or a deliberative body receive testimony and evidence.
Employers’ willingness and ability to hire workers at different compensation levels.
Uncertainty arising because a survey measures a sample rather than the entire population.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “reserve requirement”?
options: A rule concerning reserves relative to deposits; requirements have changed over time and may be set at zero.
A smaller legislative body that studies, drafts, and reviews bills or conducts oversight.
A person who organizes resources, bears uncertainty, and develops products, services, or processes.
The value of exports minus imports of goods and services.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “transmission mechanism”?
options: The channels through which monetary policy affects financial conditions, spending, employment, and prices.
The election in which voters choose among nominees and decide public offices or measures.
A market with many firms selling differentiated products and relatively easy entry.
The price of one currency in terms of another.

questions.question: Which action best demonstrates mastery of the Week 31 inquiry?
options: A student selects an answer only because it sounds confident, even when the record is incomplete or contradictory.
A student identifies the specific policy tool and transmission channel rather than claiming the Federal Reserve directly sets all consumer interest rates or prices.
A student accepts the first available claim or offer without checking the source, terms, evidence, or consequences.
A student relies on political identity, advertising, or personal preference as a substitute for documented analysis.
questions.explanation: A student identifies the specific policy tool and transmission channel rather than claiming the Federal Reserve directly sets all consumer interest rates or prices.
